name: Deserialization: Java/PHP/Python probes -> gadget RCE
goal: Fingerprint which native deserializer the app feeds, then converge on a gadget-driven RCE.
preconditions: Native-encoded data in cookies, bodies, viewstate-like blobs, or import features.
impact: Code execution via gadget chains (Java CommonsCollections etc.), object injection (PHP), arbitrary Python execution (pickle).

steps.purpose: Detect Java native deserialization (rO0AB surfaces) and object-graph handling.
steps.on_success: Gadget selection (heapdump helps: redteam/Spring Boot actuator heapdump) -> step 4.
steps.on_fail: No Java surface -> step 2/3 for PHP/Python.

steps.on_success: PHP route: gadget via phar:// or ThinkPHP -> step 4.

steps.purpose: Pickle surface detection (gASV blobs, invalid-load-key oracle).
steps.on_success: Pickle RCE payloads via __reduce__ (documented next step) -> step 4.
steps.on_fail: None of three -> YAML deserialization or .NET ViewState (documented gaps; note them honestly).

steps.purpose: Converge: OS-layer proof once a gadget executes.
steps.on_success: Chain narrative closed with deterministic marker.

entry_points: API bodies with base64 blobs (base64 starts rO0AB / gASV / Tzo)

recon.name: Blob census
recon.how: Collect every base64/hex blob the app sets; prefix-match against native serializers (rO0AB=Java, O:=PHP, gASV=pickle, /wEy=.NET).

recon.name: Library census via heapdump
recon.how: Actuator heapdump strings reveal gadget libraries (commons-collections versions) before payload crafting.

recon.name: phar angle
recon.how: PHP file operations on phar streams unserialize metadata — pair any file-read/upload with phar probes.

recon.name: Import-format inventory
recon.how: Native-format imports (Java native RPC, PHP session upload progress, Python job queues) are the classic sinks.

variants: Shiro rememberMe AES with leaked key
pivot_hints: RCE -> internal network + config -> cloud_takeover chains
gadget lib versions -> matching public gadget lists
